extension.summary: Kodi diagnostics, Add-on Doctor, install history and crash correlation
extension.description: Checks Kodi health, classifies log problems, manages repositories with reversible enable/disable controls, offers approved repairs, Fix My Kodi safe repairs, dependency diagnostics, reversible repository controls, one-tap Quick Clean, verified complete backup and Controller-safe exact restore, undo, advanced storage cleanup and support-package export, a built-in Repository Installer, one-click Easy Repo Installer setup, visible issues-first batch Auto Repair without legacy per-item rescans/notifications, plus an approved fallback repository catalog that can be checked in one pass when installed repositories do not provide a missing add-on, and a built-in Add-on Exporter for any installed add-on (with optional saved data), and Help & Guide with SAFE, CAUTION and ADVANCED explanations. Version 2.4 adds automatic native-crash signature recognition for PythonInvoker aborts, playback-stop correlation, bounded nearby add-on ID clues, and clearer incident analysis while keeping the 2.3 bounded recorder/exporter. Native stacks are not guaranteed; this is diagnostic tooling, not a crash fix. Version 2.5.2 replaces the legacy skin exporter with a read-only clean-core Infinity Skin Export for skin.infinity and its own saved skin data. Version 2.5.8 adds post-Start-Fresh native incident correlation, app-owned fatal-signal record export, module/offset evidence and explicit trace-attempt status. Version 2.5.9 completes a function-contract audit: dashboard/version metadata are synchronized, Help & Guide now matches the bounded Auto Repair implementation, and the cache-only Clean Mode safety contract remains explicit. Version 2.5.10 adds Scan Kodi evidence directly to every support ZIP as redacted scan-results.json and scan-details.txt, including current errors, likely crashes/script failures, full actionable issue details, known-noise entries, leftover-data inventory and historical-only errors; the diagnostic package label now follows the installed version. Version 2.5.11 makes scan status issue-aware instead of crash-only, adds deduplicated runtime findings for skin-window collisions, legacy database/keymap problems and selected add-on/auth runtime signals, and prevents semantic add-on/skin versions from being mistaken for IPv4 addresses during support redaction. Version 2.5.12 correlates self-recovered authentication errors so successful token refreshes no longer remain active warnings, exports recovered runtime findings separately, and lets bounded Auto Repair recreate TMDb Helper working folders when that exact safe issue is detected. Version 2.5.6 adds the unified Infinity Health Center dashboard, responsive card layout, a clear Start Fresh crash-baseline control, and baseline-aware diagnostic export so historical pre-baseline crash text is not automatically attributed to a new test. Version 2.5 adds Add-on Doctor, missing/disabled required-dependency analysis, local install/update history, bounded timing-only crash correlation, an exportable doctor report, and a small health bridge for Infinity recovery tools. Version 2.5.1 adds Refresh Codes: a safe one-tap diagnostic baseline reset that starts fresh Health Center codes/history without deleting Kodi settings, add-ons, backups, skin data, or Android system crash buffers. Version 2.5.14 tightens missing-dependency detection so optional/runtime Addon(id) probes are not mislabeled as required dependencies, adds a backup-first repair for the exact legacy Super Favourites xbmc.runscript keymap action observed on-device, and synchronizes internal Health Center/Add-on Doctor/fallback-dashboard version metadata. Version 2.5.15 adds privacy-safe Authorization Health: Account Manager Lite master-state checks, Trakt target consistency, refresh failure/recovery correlation, and authorization-health.json/txt in support exports without credential values or fingerprints. Version 2.5.17 separates retained native history from the selected session, preserves event IDs and timestamps, flags unreliable engine identity stamps, adds bounded privacy-minimized tombstone summaries and FD/memory telemetry, and distinguishes local authorization consistency from live server verification.
